verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost identical, and both have the same flaws. The ram skull and yellow bar keep their proportions, but the whole layout is pushed up, leaving about 120px of dead white space at the bottom. The small attribution line also sits a couple of pixels left of the quote's left edge. The only difference is where the attribution sits. In A it is a bit tight under the quote, about the same relative gap as the original. In B the gap is wider and the attribution looks slightly detached. Neither difference matters enough to pick a winner.
